01_acceptance_and_shift: Observed certificate acceptance with 95% Wilson binomial intervals under the synthetic generator. The red dashed line is the frozen 95% empirical target. Intervals quantify sampling uncertainty under that generator; they do not establish population reliability, physical validity or a customer SLA. These are the original protected cases before fallback; hardened revalidation preserved all counts.
02_frozen_feasibility_boundaries: Frozen 5 s standard and 0.25 s interactive numerical-core contracts. Each point is one observed 32-case batch. Original protected timings, guarded exposed-case revalidation and measured guarded fallback chains are shown separately. Original adaptive batches met 0.25 s, while guarded batches straddled the boundary. Work48 and Gym48 each refused two original cases; full repair accepted all 64. These few timing observations do not establish a production SLA, and thresholds were not changed. The 5 s numerical gate excludes the assumed model and preparation pipeline; end-to-end reservations of 95/125/182 s for audit/screen/selection are simulated assumptions, not measured latency.
03_fresh_offering_prototype: Final protected seed 7401: eight damping-selection cases, each with eight distinct gain settings. Every policy selected the independent oracle optimum in 8/8 cases with zero regret. Times include numerical matrix preparation, certificates, fallback and ranking refinement; independent audit solves are excluded. Ordinary adaptive tools already meet the frozen 2 s contract. The retained work basis is faster, while Gym incurs eight direct ranking refinements. This is an observed technical comparison on synthetic systems, not a market or frontier-model performance result. The 2 s gate excludes assumed frontier-model preparation; the 182 s complete selection-service reservation is simulated and was not measured by this experiment.
04_capability_lineage: Observed artifact lineage. Six synthetic origin solutions produce the rank 48 work basis. Optional Gym selects four additional full solutions from 20 development probes and refits at the same rank. Work and Gym versions enter the final prototype separately. The Gym artifact is also loaded by a separate recipient process on four fresh inputs with digest verification. Native authorization/accounting checks are local fixtures; neither live ENS authentication nor protected production admission is claimed. No real customer payment is attributed to the origin solves.
05_cpu_only_break_even: Deliberately favorable, CPU-only sensitivity using the fresh 7401 work-basis saving over ordinary adaptive tools. The assumed price is $0.50 per core-hour and the hypothetical added budgets are $20 and $61. The two figures are aggregate added-cost budgets; any upkeep already budgeted is included once. Additional unbudgeted upkeep, failed transfer, obsolescence, opportunity cost and delay are excluded. The thresholds are therefore optimistic lower bounds for these cost hypotheses, not workload forecasts or proven commercial payback. No higher selling price or demand is credited to a capability that did not uniquely enable the service.
06_cumulative_incremental_profit: Conditional simulated cumulative operating profit relative to an equally resourced competent-Beta enterprise. Lines average the paired confirmation seeds under the frozen base assumptions. Revenue, buyer decisions, market prices and commercial overhead are simulated, while numerical cost differences come from executed technical evidence. Shared work and an ordinary library with identical contents and permissions have identical outcomes. The graph does not validate demand or demonstrate earned revenue. Forced investment treatments are explanatory ablations.
07_portfolio_and_available_funds: Conditional simulated portfolio and balances. Left: average active offerings across confirmation seeds; every enterprise may qualify the same three technically deliverable services. Growth in this count does not establish a specialist-created frontier crossing or a new market. Right: the selective policy's operating profit and available funds are distinct. Available funds include the remaining seed capital and reflect collections, obligations and reserves; seed capital is not revenue. Market and buyer assumptions remain unvalidated.
08_economic_stress_frontier: Mean paired incremental profit relative to competent Beta across the frozen stress scenarios. Cells are conditional simulation outcomes, rounded to the nearest dollar, not forecasts or customer evidence. Parameter changes stress demand, pricing, failures, integration, transfer, capacity, distribution shift, collection delays, ordinary-tool progress, compute price and growth financed by available surplus. Monte Carlo intervals and full assumptions remain in the machine-readable evidence; simulation precision does not remove uncertainty in those assumptions.
